* feat: support OpenCode 2 by @arttttt in https://github.com/arttttt/opencode-agent-dock/pull/5
* chore: release 1.1.0 by @arttttt in https://github.com/arttttt/opencode-agent-dock/pull/6


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/arttttt/opencode-agent-dock/compare/1.0.1...1.1.0

* fix: ship compiled JS, so the npm install loads by @arttttt in https://github.com/arttttt/opencode-agent-dock/pull/2
* chore: release 1.0.1 by @arttttt in https://github.com/arttttt/opencode-agent-dock/pull/3
